notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); no hardware was attached and native.py was never imported. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's decision family-config / helper ScpiDriver was replaced by a direct Driver over pyinstrument.instrument:PSupply with a native.py factory. PSupply is an object API whose methods assemble the SCPI lines from a literal and a number at run time ('VOLT ' + str(Volt), pyinstrument/instrument.py:82; 'CURR ' + str(Current), line 86) around a caller-supplied VISA resource (lines 61-62), which a family command table cannot bind. The wire syntax is the upstream's and was not altered. The upstream has no simulator and no tests, so fake.py is an in-memory stand-in for the six PSupply methods the driver calls; every canned number is marked '# placeholder'. The upstream states no voltage or current range, so both setpoints are Limit.operator_required and are refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until site-limits.json is written; site-limits.example.json supplies example operator bounds (0-30 V, 0-5 A) and is what G8 serves. cap.measure.voltage.v1 and cap.measure.current.v1 are bound with only the supported class inputs (dc / channel); the card's cap.sensing.read.v1 hint was not used because its resource_kinds are sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument.smu. The card's on/off hints are covered by the writable boolean output_enabled (PSupply.on/off). PSupply.chk only queries *IDN? and prints, and PSupply.delay is a sleep helper, so neither is a capability. The class comment names 'N5477 and Tecktronics' but no README or code line states a model or a vendor, so the driver claims neither. All values are scalars; there is no array to leave uncovered. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); a human must review it before hardware use. No catalogue_requests: no extension ids were used.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
